title: Source: Cursor reached $3B in annualized revenue in late April and now has 3,000+ customers paying at least $100K each for its software on an annualized basis (Rachel Metz/Bloomberg)
summary: Rachel Metz / Bloomberg: Source: Cursor reached $3B in annualized revenue in late April and now has 3,000+ customers paying at least $100K each for its software on an annualized basis — Cursor's annualized revenue hit $3 billion in late April, according to a person familiar with the matter, indicating growing demand …
